document.abstract: The march of progress has made IP an inevitability in the broadcasting environment. However, while this brings many possibilities, it brings its own set of challenges as well. IP is still new to many, and companies will need to understand how putting IP on their network will affect their ability to deliver the services and the service quality their customers and their contracts demand.
